cards.explanation: The answer is a colt, friends. Jesus says they'll find one tied there as soon as they enter the village (Mark 11:2). He gives the whole plan before they take a single step. I'd have forgotten what I was sent for by the second street.

The answer is True, friends. Jesus calls it a colt "…on which no one has ever sat." (Mark 11:2) A colt with no riding miles on it at all. I know a thing or two about being well used, and this colt is the opposite.

Jesus tells them to say, "The Lord needs it and will return it shortly." (Mark 11:3) Short, clear, and it even says the colt is coming back, friends. I wish my instructions came that tidy. Mine usually end with "you'll figure it out."

The answer is False, friends. The disciples answer as Jesus instructed, and "…the people gave them permission." (Mark 11:6) No standoff, no arguing. I bet those two let out a breath they'd been holding the whole walk.

The answer is True, friends. The disciples lead the colt to Jesus, throw their cloaks over it, "…and He sat on it." (Mark 11:7) The colt nobody had ridden before now has Jesus on it. The errand worked out just as He said.

The answer is branches, friends! Others in the crowd spread "…branches they had cut from the fields." (Mark 11:8) Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread the branches. Cloaks and branches, all laid down on the road.

The answer is David, friends! The crowd shouts, "Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!" (Mark 11:10) David was made king over Israel (2 Samuel 5:3), and the crowd calls him "our father." The ones who went ahead and those who followed were all shouting.
The answer is True, friends. Jesus entered Jerusalem "…and went into the temple courts." (Mark 11:11) After the shouting on the road, that's where He goes. And there He looks around at everything.

The answer is that He goes out to Bethany with the Twelve, friends. Since it was already late, Jesus "…went out to Bethany with the Twelve." (Mark 11:11) He looks around at everything first, and then He heads out. And the story isn't over yet.
